parameters.name: DIJobId
parameters.description: The task ID associated with the alert rule.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description of the alert rule.

parameters.name: Enabled
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable the alert rule. By default, the alert rule is disabled.

parameters.name: MetricType
parameters.description:
The alert metric type. Valid values:
- Heartbeat: task status alert.
- FailoverCount: failover count alert.
- Delay: task latency alert.
- DdlReport: DDL notification.
- ResourceUtilization: resource group utilization.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the alert rule.

parameters.name: TriggerConditions
parameters.description: The list of alert trigger conditions. Multiple conditions are supported.

sub_parameters.name: DdlTypes
sub_parameters.description: The list of DDL types that take effect. This parameter takes effect only when the metric type is DDL notification.

sub_parameters.name: Duration
sub_parameters.description: The time window for alert calculation. Unit: minutes.

sub_parameters.name: Severity
sub_parameters.description:
The severity level. Valid values:
- Warning
- Critical

sub_parameters.name: Threshold
sub_parameters.description:
The alert threshold.
- Task status alert: no threshold is required.
- Failover count alert: the threshold is the number of failovers.
- Task latency alert: the threshold is the latency duration. Unit: seconds.
